tokens.name: blue-301
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] Pantone 301C. Main brand colour: logo, document covers, cranes. On screen: primary buttons, links, chart bars, progress fills, brand hero cards, the primary icon stroke. White text on it 6.67:1.

tokens.name: grey-431
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] Pantone 431C. Secondary colour for typography and graphic block elements. On screen: body text on light grounds (5.18:1 on ground, 5.91:1 on surface, 4.74:1 on blue-wash), control borders. Fails as body text on grey-sarens (4.36:1).

tokens.name: yellow-108
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] Pantone 108C. Highlighting colour, used infrequently. On screen: an accent fill carrying blue-deep text (11.89:1), or a mark on surface-contrast and brand-fill. Never text, never a status, never a mark on a light ground (1.29:1 on white).

tokens.name: grey-sarens
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] Grey Sarens. Alternative background. On screen: table header rows and hairlines on light; body text on dark (11.34:1).

tokens.name: white-sarens
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] White Sarens. Background colour. On screen: cards on the light ground, text on blue-301 and blue-deep.

tokens.name: marine-281
tokens.usage: [Manual p.46–47] Pantone 281C. Reserved exclusively for work clothes and certain vehicles. Never in any screen, poster, newsletter or e-learning. Listed only so no one reintroduces it.

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] 50% tint of blue-301 with white. Secondary icon tone, unselected chart bars with a value label, muted text on surface-contrast in light (6.72:1); links, control borders and focus ring on dark. Never text on light (2.0:1 on ground).

tokens.name: blue-wash
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] 15% tint of blue-301 with white. The tinted card surface on light. grey-431 on it 4.74:1, blue-301 5.34:1, blue-deep 12.31:1.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] blue-301 darkened to 40%. Dark page ground. Since 12 Nov 2026 also the contrast card and strong text colour on light (15.37:1 on white, 13.45:1 on ground), and the text colour on yellow.

tokens.name: blue-deep-raised
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] blue-301 at 50%. Cards on the dark ground.

tokens.name: blue-deep-band
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] blue-301 at 70%. Tracks, hairlines and the tinted card on dark.

tokens.name: grey-tint
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] grey-sarens 45% with white. Light page ground, and wells inside white cards.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Cards float on it; nothing else sits directly on it except the page headline and the nav.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default card, field and menu surface. Flat at rest: depth is the colour step from ground. Shadow only on hover and on floating layers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Wells inside a surface card: list rows, nested tiles, segmented-control tracks, unselected chips. ink on it 5.18:1 light, 11.34:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-contrast
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The one dark card that anchors a view, selected chips, the segmented-control thumb, contrast buttons. Text on it is on-contrast. At most two contrast cards in a view.

tokens.name: on-contrast
tokens.usage: Headings, figures and body text on surface-contrast. 15.37:1 light, 6.67:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-contrast-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive marks on surface-contrast. 6.72:1 light, 4.93:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-wash
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The tinted card: a quieter second colour block beside white and contrast cards. Body text on it is ink (4.74:1 light, 7.60:1 dark); headings ink-strong.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] A layer floating over a photo or a contrast card, always with backdrop-filter blur-glass. Text on glass is ink-strong only (8.56:1 worst case light, 5.63:1 dark); never ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] blue-deep at 72%. The block laid over a photo so text can sit on it, in print and video only. Text on it is white-sarens: 6.16:1 over the whitest photo, 17.39:1 over the darkest. Never a gradient, never under 72%. Email cannot draw it: there, text sits on a solid block beside the photo.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Table header rows and selected rows. Text on band: ink-strong or ink-heading only at body size. Progress tracks do not use it: a track is the surface's strong ink at 14% opacity, so it shows on every card.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and chart gridlines. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, captions, table cells on ground, surface, surface-sunken and surface-wash. Light 5.18 / 5.91 / 5.18 / 4.74:1; dark 11.34 / 10.04 / 11.34 / 7.60:1. Never on band in light (4.36:1), never on glass.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Headlines, titles, card headings and figures on ground, surface, surface-sunken, surface-wash, band and glass. Light 13.45:1 on ground, 15.37:1 on surface; dark 15.37:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ink-heading
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text: eyebrow labels, the emphasised phrase in a headline, selected labels. On ground, surface, wash and band. Light 5.84 / 6.67 / 5.34 / 4.93:1.

tokens.name: ink-link
tokens.usage: Links and text buttons on ground and surface. Dark 6.72 / 5.95:1; on dark band 4.50:1, so avoid links in dark wash cards.

tokens.name: brand-fill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, brand hero cards, progress fills, the selected chart bar. Same blue in both themes.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-fill (6.67:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The accent fill: one yellow card, button or chip per view carrying on-highlight text, plus small marks (dots, done-days, one chart bar) inside surface-contrast or brand-fill. Never text, status, or a mark on ground, surface, wash or sunken.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a highlight fill (11.89:1). Changed from blue-301 on 12 Nov 2026. Never white on yellow (1.29:1).

tokens.name: data-strong
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The datum that matters: progress fills, ring values, the selected chart bar. Light 6.67:1 on surface; dark 13.61:1. On surface-contrast and brand-fill the strong datum is highlight instead.

tokens.name: data-quiet
tokens.usage: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The other data: unselected chart bars. About 2:1 on surface in both themes, so every quiet bar carries a value label.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of text fields, outline buttons, outline chips and checkboxes. Light 5.18:1 on ground; dark 6.72:1 on ground.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. Light 5.84:1 on ground; dark 6.72:1. On surface-contrast and brand-fill use on-contrast; on highlight use on-highlight.

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: Primary icon stroke: the part that names the thing. Light 5.84:1 on ground; dark 15.37:1.

tokens.name: icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary icon stroke: frame or context. 2.0:1 on light ground, so two-tone icons always sit beside a text label.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] Good / on track. Marks only (icon, dot, bar), always with a word. 3.76:1 on light ground, 3.58:1 on dark ground. Never on surface-contrast or brand-fill: put the status chip's own surface under it.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] Warning / due soon. Burnt orange, deliberately far from yellow-108. Marks only, always with a word. 3.55:1 light, 3.79:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: [Added, MarCom-approved 06 Nov 2026] Bad / overdue / failed. Marks only, always with a word. 3.89:1 light, 3.46:1 dark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between progress segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; gap between a figure and its caption; gap between stacked cards on mobile; nav rail padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows; table cell padding (vertical 8, horizontal 12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in compact density; gap between stacked controls; gap between cards under 900px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter between cards on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop; hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; poster margins at A-series scale start here.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and title-screen spacing.

radius.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Screens are rounded; print stays square. Nested corners are concentric: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them, never below radius-xs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tooltips, table row hover, chart bars under 16px wide, the smallest nested tile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields inside cards, square icon tiles, cards in compact density's nested level.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows and tiles nested in a card; images inside a card; cards in compact density.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, the welcome hero, sheets and modals, cards on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, search fields, nav rails, progress tracks.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, avatars, status dots, calendar days.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Print only: posters and newsletters keep the manual's square blocks. Never on a screen component.

shadow.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Cards are flat at rest. Shadow is feedback (hover) or separation (a layer floating over content), never decoration.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Retired 12 Nov 2026: cards are flat at rest again. Kept for one version; do not use.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: An interactive card or button under the pointer, with a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating nav bars, menus, popovers, tooltips, modals.

grid.note: [Manual p.53–55] A grid is always mandatory; the exact Müller-Brockmann reticle is not. Screen values below are [Added].

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Desktop columns. 8 on tablet, 4 on mobile. Cards span whole columns.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between cards on desktop, equal to space-6. space-4 under 900px, space-2 for a stacked mobile column.

tokens.name: grid-margin
tokens.usage: Outer page margin on desktop (16px under 600px).

tokens.name: grid-max-width
tokens.usage: Content width cap for dashboards and welcome pages.

stroke.note: [Added] Line weights for icons, hairlines and focus.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, chart gridlines, grid motif lines, control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke on the 24px icon grid.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, with a 2px offset.

size.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Control heights. Nothing a finger or pointer has to hit is smaller than size-control-md, except inside compact tables.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, compact-density buttons, row actions inside tables.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, fields, segmented controls, nav items.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The one main action on a welcome page or e-learning title screen; floating nav bar height.

blur.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Backdrop blur for surface-glass.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter: blur() on every surface-glass layer. Glass without blur is not allowed: the text contrast depends on it.

print.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The poster canvas. Build every poster at A3 in CSS px; A4, A2 and A1 are the same file scaled, because the A series keeps one proportion.

tokens.name: print-canvas-w
tokens.usage: A3 portrait width: 297mm at 96px to the inch. 1mm is 3.78px; 1px prints as 0.75pt.

tokens.name: print-canvas-h
tokens.usage: A3 portrait height: 420mm. Swap the two for landscape.

tokens.name: print-columns
tokens.usage: Columns across the whole sheet. Blocks snap to them and may bleed off the edge.

tokens.name: print-rows
tokens.usage: Rows down the whole sheet.

tokens.name: print-margin
tokens.usage: 12.7mm on A3 (space-12). No text, logo or QR code sits closer to the trim than this.

tokens.name: print-bleed
tokens.usage: Added by MarCom or the print shop on every side for trimmed work. Office printing needs none.

video.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] The video frame, its clear margin and its timing. Timings are in ms; at 30 frames a second one frame is 33ms.

tokens.name: video-canvas-w
tokens.usage: Frame width for 16:9. 9:16 is 1080 by 1920 and 1:1 is 1080 by 1080, rebuilt, never cropped.

tokens.name: video-canvas-h
tokens.usage: Frame height for 16:9.

tokens.name: video-fps
tokens.usage: Frames a second. Export H.264 MP4.

tokens.name: video-margin
tokens.usage: 5% of the width. All text and logos stay inside it. In 9:16 keep the top 250px and the bottom 340px clear as well.

tokens.name: video-move
tokens.usage: The longest any single movement runs: an entrance, a wipe, a count-up. 18 frames.

tokens.name: video-beat
tokens.usage: The rest between two movements, and the length of a block wipe. 15 frames.

tokens.name: video-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between items entering as a group. Five items at most.

tokens.name: video-hold-min
tokens.usage: The shortest time any text stays still on screen. Longer lines hold 400ms a word plus 1000ms.

tokens.name: video-ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles. The same curve as --ease-out on screens.

tokens.name: video-ease-in
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.

email.note: [Added 12 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by MarCom] Email newsletter measures. Email clients cannot read custom properties: copy these values, and the brand hex values, into inline styles.

tokens.name: email-width
tokens.usage: Width of the one content column. On a phone it shrinks to the screen.

tokens.name: email-padding
tokens.usage: Left and right padding inside the column, and the space between stories (space-6).

tokens.name: email-button-height
tokens.usage: Height of a button cell. Square corners: Outlook draws no radius.
